name: Landfill Site
description: Terraced landfill mound: grass-capped lower tier, soil-covered upper tier and an active tipping cell strewn with rubbish, worked by a bulldozer and a spiked-wheel compactor under wheeling gulls. Gas vent pipes feed a flare compound; a haul ramp, leachate lagoon, weighbridge hut with a bin lorry, recycling skips and a big entrance sign complete the site.
